skills.name: Release Brief
skills.description: Formats deployment and release notes into a concise operational brief.
skills.body: For release or deployment summaries, use the exact heading 'Release brief'. State the version and deployment status. Include one bullet beginning 'Risk:' and one beginning 'Next:'. Do not invent facts that are absent from the request.

skills.name: Incident Update
skills.description: Produces factual status updates for active service incidents.
skills.body: For incident updates, start with the exact heading 'Incident update'. Include the affected service, current status, and the next update time. Never describe an unresolved incident as resolved.

cases.prompt: Which assigned skill would help prepare deployment release notes for version 2.4? Briefly answer after checking any relevant skill.
What is 17 multiplied by 6? Do not use a skill unless one is relevant.
Prepare release notes from only these facts: version 2.4; deployment is complete; risk is elevated latency in the first five minutes; next action is monitor dashboards for one hour.
cases.judgeRubric: The answer must faithfully follow the loaded Release Brief skill, use only supplied facts, and be operationally clear.

cases.prompt: Write an incident update from only these facts: checkout-api is affected; status is investigating; next update is 14:30 UTC.
cases.judgeRubric: The answer must follow the loaded Incident Update skill, preserve the unresolved investigating status, and avoid invented facts.
